scope: Prospective matched gamma-only development experiment; no selection, app update or independent acceptance.
optimisation: Fresh identical seeded models; Adam betas .9/.999 eps1e-8 wd0; linear L1 only; cosine20; no early stopping, AMP, augmentation, clipping, TV or warm start.

evaluation.all_six_arms: Run all predeclared seeds regardless of first-seed outcome, unless integrity/non-finite failure stops the job.
evaluation.screen: Internal development screen only: paired seed-average mean dev DE00 improvement >=0.25, all three seeds lower dev mean than their matched legacy, seed-average mean per-scene dev p95 no worse. Every scene/group/regression reported; no automatic selection.
evaluation.primary_set: 116 development scenes, whole-session disjoint from467 fit; not independent acceptance after previous research.
evaluation.DR100: All12 DR100 sources are development-only; no fit support. Report explicitly as out-of-support/extrapolation, never DR100 qualification.
evaluation.guide_caveat: The unchanged rec709 luma guide is computed from each arm's own input; linear G changes guide-bin occupancy. A negative result does not refute the corrected decode or prove absence of information.
evaluation.R11: Preserved selected checkpoint; not an endpoint control or unseen-dev comparator. New models never load its weights.
